scope: honest fold-3-to-4 and fold-4-to-3 transfer audit for group-level conformal false-positive risk control

risk_control.direction_rule: calibrate on fold 3 and confirm on fold 4, then calibrate on fold 4 and confirm on fold 3
risk_control.claim: expected group-balanced FPR for future exchangeable 25 km groups only

pre_outcome_runtime_amendment.reason: The first invocation was terminated before any output because the exact reference threshold scan was quadratic in crop count.
pre_outcome_runtime_amendment.change: Replace only the scan implementation with a sort-and-increment exact equivalent; four unit-test alphas prove identical feasibility, threshold, and corrected risk.

gates.failure_action: retain the curve as a negative calibration result but do not replace the current operating rule

invariants: Each confirmation fold is scored only at thresholds selected from the other fold.
No fold 2, folds 0/1, official test, or external held outcome is loaded.
Sensor results are empirical diagnostics, not conditional conformal guarantees.
No single global threshold is claimed to control risk under geographic shift without exchangeability.
